notes: A database restart (an Ubuntu update of PostgreSQL, a restore) no longer stops the app; it reconnects by itself.
Client portal: accounts more than 12 hours old could not sign in ("Something went wrong saving to the database"). Fixed.
Automatic updates: when the update service can't be reached, the message says why (DNS, firewall, certificate...) and IPv4 is tried again.
Updates › Installations: pick the server from a list (St. George, Louisiana Gold & Coins, demo sandbox, this office); client is optional.
Office Your Day: client support requests widget.
Client portal support (used only by Fenmorix Technologies' own server).
Automatic updates: this server can check in with its update service, download signed updates for itself, and (if you turn it on) install them at night.
System › License: switch licensed modules off and back on, without a new license. Nothing is deleted.
When a secure sign-in in front of the app ends, a clear message with a Reload button replaces "Failed to fetch".
System page: the update box names this server's own update zip.
Linux: new restore script for moving an install to a new server.
